executive_summary: The coordinated assessment contains 8 referenced evidence records and 5 referenced non-causal claim candidates across governance, economics, education, public_health. Unsupported inference boundaries remain active, including causal inference. The report preserves observational and non-causal boundaries from upstream artifacts. No external literature or outside contextual evidence has been integrated.

analysis_findings.message: complete-case analysis excluded rows with missing required values

limitations_section.narrative_summary: The report preserves upstream limitation codes and keeps interpretation bounded to structured, non-causal Polaris artifacts.

methodology_section.coordination_process: Phase 7 coordinated 4 domain assessments by reference.
methodology_section.domain_agent_process: Phase 6 deterministic domain agents selected relevant structured evidence and claim IDs without adding outside context.
methodology_section.evidence_extraction_process: Phase 5 extracted 13 evidence records and 7 bounded non-causal claim candidates.
methodology_section.grounding_and_validation: Phase 8 synthesis supplied validated summaries with fabricated-reference, limitation-preservation, unsupported-inference, and overreach checks.
methodology_section.ingestion_and_validation: Local CSV ingestion mapped source columns to the supplied manifest, normalized supported scalar values, validated structure, and computed a SHA-256 checksum.
methodology_section.sample_construction: Phase 4 used complete-case sample construction from accepted Phase 3 records.
